*{box-sizing:border-box;}
html,body{margin:0;padding:0;background:#EFE9F7;}
body{font-family:'Nunito',sans-serif;color:var(--ink);}
:root{
  --mint:#BFEAE0; --mint-soft:#E7F7F2; --mint-deep:#2E8E74;
  --pink:#F6C2D9; --pink-soft:#FDEEF4; --pink-deep:#C43E77;
  --purple:#CBB9EA; --purple-soft:#F1EBFA; --purple-deep:#6B4BA1;
  --sun:#F4CE6A; --sun-soft:#FFF6E0; --sun-deep:#A8730A;
  --sun-fill:#F2B705; --sun-ink:#4A3200;
  --red:#EE8C7A; --red-soft:#FDEEEA; --red-deep:#BE3A22;
  --brand:#2D1B69; --brand-accent:#E8450A;
  --ink:#392B4D; --ink-soft:#7A6E90;
  --paper:#FFFEFC; --line:#E6DAF3;
}
.doc{max-width:210mm;margin:0 auto;}
.pdf-page{
  width:210mm;height:297mm;background:var(--paper);
  position:relative;margin:10mm auto;
  box-shadow:0 10px 40px rgba(107,75,161,.18);
  overflow:hidden;
}
.bleed-label{
  position:absolute;top:3mm;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;
  font-family:'Nunito';font-size:6.5pt;color:#B8ABCF;letter-spacing:.08em;
}
.panel{
  position:relative;margin:9mm;width:calc(210mm - 18mm);height:calc(297mm - 18mm);
  box-sizing:border-box;border:2.4pt solid var(--purple-deep);
  border-radius:7mm;padding:13mm 13mm 10mm;overflow:hidden;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:var(--paper);
}
.deco{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none;z-index:0;}
.deco-mint{background:var(--mint);opacity:.45;}
.deco-pink{background:var(--pink);opacity:.4;}
.deco-purple{background:var(--purple);opacity:.35;}
.deco-tr{width:64mm;height:64mm;top:-26mm;right:-22mm;}
.deco-bl{width:46mm;height:46mm;bottom:-18mm;left:-16mm;}
.panel > *:not(.deco){position:relative;z-index:1;}

.kicker{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:2mm;width:fit-content;
  font-family:'Nunito';font-weight:800;font-size:8pt;letter-spacing:.1em;
  text-transform:uppercase;padding:2mm 5mm;border-radius:20mm;margin-bottom:5mm;
}
.kicker.t-mint{background:var(--mint-soft);color:var(--mint-deep);}
.kicker.t-pink{background:var(--pink-soft);color:var(--pink-deep);}
.kicker.t-purple{background:var(--purple-soft);color:var(--purple-deep);}

.page-title{font-family:'Quicksand';font-weight:700;font-size:24pt;color:var(--ink);margin:0 0 3mm;line-height:1.15;}
.page-subtitle{font-family:'Nunito';font-weight:600;font-size:11pt;color:var(--ink-soft);margin:0 0 6mm;line-height:1.5;max-width:145mm;}
.underline{display:block;width:22mm;height:2.4mm;border-radius:2mm;margin:3mm 0 6mm;}
.u-mint{background:var(--mint-deep);} .u-pink{background:var(--pink-deep);} .u-purple{background:var(--purple-deep);}

.body-text{font-family:'Nunito';font-size:10.3pt;line-height:1.6;color:var(--ink);}
.body-text p{margin:0 0 2.6mm;}
.body-text strong{color:var(--purple-deep);font-weight:800;}

ul.nice{list-style:none;margin:0 0 2.8mm;padding:0;}
ul.nice li{position:relative;padding-left:6.5mm;margin-bottom:1.9mm;font-size:10.1pt;line-height:1.42;}
ul.nice li::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;top:2mm;width:3mm;height:3mm;border-radius:50%;}
ul.nice.c-mint li::before{background:var(--mint-deep);}
ul.nice.c-pink li::before{background:var(--pink-deep);}
ul.nice.c-purple li::before{background:var(--purple-deep);}

.check-box{border:.9pt solid #DDCEF3;border-radius:5mm;padding:4mm 5mm;background:#FDFBFF;margin-bottom:3mm;}
.check-box .cb-title{font-family:'Quicksand';font-weight:700;font-size:11pt;color:var(--purple-deep);margin:0 0 2mm;}
ul.check{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;}
ul.check li{position:relative;padding-left:7mm;margin-bottom:1.7mm;font-size:9.4pt;line-height:1.38;}
ul.check li::before{content:'✓';position:absolute;left:0;top:-0.3mm;width:5mm;height:5mm;border-radius:1.6mm;
  background:var(--mint-soft);color:var(--mint-deep);font-weight:800;font-size:8pt;text-align:center;line-height:5mm;}

.adapt-mini{margin-top:2.4mm;padding-top:2.4mm;border-top:1pt dashed var(--line);}
.adapt-mini .am-title{font-family:'Quicksand';font-weight:700;font-size:9.6pt;color:var(--purple-deep);margin:0 0 1.8mm;}
.adapt-mini-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:2mm 3mm;}
.adapt-mini-row{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:1.8mm;}
.adapt-mini-row .am-icon{width:5.4mm;height:5.4mm;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
.adapt-mini-row .am-icon svg{width:3mm;height:3mm;}
.adapt-mini-row .am-text{font-family:'Nunito';font-size:8.4pt;line-height:1.28;color:var(--ink);padding-top:0.2mm;}
.adapt-mini-row .am-text strong{color:var(--ink);font-weight:800;display:block;font-size:8.6pt;}

.adapt-row{display:flex;gap:4mm;margin-bottom:5mm;}
.adapt-chip{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:1.6mm;text-align:center;}
.adapt-chip .aic-wrap{width:11mm;height:11mm;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
.adapt-chip svg{width:6mm;height:6mm;}
.adapt-chip .alabel{font-family:'Nunito';font-weight:800;font-size:6.6pt;letter-spacing:.03em;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.2;}

.adapt-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:2.4mm;margin-top:0.5mm;}
.adapt-card{border-radius:4.5mm;padding:2.8mm 3.5mm;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1.3mm;}
.adapt-card .a-icon-wrap{width:8.5mm;height:8.5mm;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
.adapt-card svg{width:4.8mm;height:4.8mm;}
.adapt-card .a-title{font-family:'Quicksand';font-weight:700;font-size:9.6pt;color:var(--ink);margin:0;}
.adapt-card .a-desc{font-family:'Nunito';font-weight:600;font-size:7.7pt;line-height:1.28;color:var(--ink-soft);margin:0;}

.quote{font-family:'Caveat';font-weight:700;font-size:16.5pt;color:var(--purple-deep);line-height:1.35;
  padding:4mm 0 4mm 8mm;border-left:2.6pt solid var(--pink-deep);margin:4mm 0;}

.photo-slot{border:2pt dashed var(--pink-deep);border-radius:5mm;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--mint-soft),var(--pink-soft) 60%,var(--purple-soft));
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  color:var(--purple-deep);font-family:'Nunito';font-weight:700;font-size:8.6pt;gap:2mm;text-align:center;padding:3mm;}
.photo-slot .ic{width:9mm;height:9mm;opacity:.85;}
.photo-slot small{font-weight:600;color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:7.4pt;}

.photo-filled{border-radius:5mm;overflow:hidden;position:relative;
  border:1.6pt solid var(--purple-deep);box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(107,75,161,.18);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;}
.photo-filled img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;flex:1;min-height:0;}
.photo-filled .photo-caption{font-family:'Nunito';font-weight:700;font-size:7.6pt;color:#fff;
  background:linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(107,75,161,.88),rgba(107,75,161,0));
  padding:6mm 4mm 2.5mm;margin-top:-14mm;text-align:center;}

.plan-photo-wrap{border-radius:5mm;overflow:hidden;flex:1;min-height:0;
  border:1.6pt solid var(--purple-deep);box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(107,75,161,.15);
  background:var(--purple-soft);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}

.two-col{display:flex;gap:8mm;flex:1;min-height:0;margin-bottom:2mm;}
.two-col > div{flex:1;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;}
.col-text{flex:1.15;} .col-photo{flex:.85;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;}
.col-photo .photo-slot{width:100%;aspect-ratio:3/4;flex:none;}
.col-photo .photo-filled{width:100%;aspect-ratio:3/4;flex:none;}

.zone-badge{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5mm;margin-bottom:5mm;}
.zone-num{font-family:'Quicksand';font-weight:700;font-size:26pt;width:20mm;height:20mm;border-radius:50%;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#fff;flex-shrink:0;}
.zone-num.z-mint{background:var(--mint-deep);} .zone-num.z-pink{background:var(--pink-deep);} .zone-num.z-purple{background:var(--purple-deep);}

.footer{margin-top:auto;padding-top:4mm;border-top:1pt solid var(--line);
  display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font-family:'Nunito';font-size:7.6pt;color:var(--ink-soft);}
.footer .fbrand{font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--purple-deep);}
.pagenum{font-family:'Quicksand';font-weight:700;color:var(--purple-deep);}

table.plan{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-family:'Nunito';font-size:9pt;margin-top:2mm;}
table.plan th{background:var(--purple-deep);color:#fff;text-align:left;padding:2.6mm 3.5mm;font-weight:700;font-size:8.6pt;}
table.plan td{padding:2.6mm 3.5mm;border-bottom:0.8pt solid var(--line);vertical-align:top;}
table.plan tr:nth-child(even) td{background:var(--mint-soft);}

.legal-note{font-family:'Nunito';font-size:8.4pt;color:var(--ink-soft);background:var(--purple-soft);
  border:.8pt solid #DDCEF3;border-radius:4mm;padding:3.6mm 4.4mm;margin-top:auto;line-height:1.45;}

/* --- Cover --- */
.cover .panel{background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--purple-deep) 0%,#8A6BC0 32%,var(--pink-deep) 78%,#E0729E 100%);
  border-color:#fff;color:#fff;justify-content:space-between;}
.cover .eyebrow{font-family:'Nunito';font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:9pt;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);padding:2mm 5mm;border-radius:20mm;width:fit-content;}
.cover h1{font-family:'Quicksand';font-weight:700;font-size:29pt;line-height:1.15;margin:5mm 0 4mm;text-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.12);flex-shrink:0;}
.cover .cov-sub{font-family:'Nunito';font-weight:600;font-size:11.5pt;max-width:130mm;line-height:1.55;opacity:.95;flex-shrink:0;margin:0 0 6mm;}
.cover .cov-photo{border:2pt dashed rgba(255,255,255,.85);background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);border-radius:6mm;
  height:132mm;flex-shrink:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;gap:2mm;color:#fff;font-weight:700;}
.cover .cov-photo.cov-photo-has-img{border:none;background:none;padding:0;display:block;}
.cov-photo-filled{width:100%;height:132mm;border-radius:6mm;overflow:hidden;
  border:1.6pt solid rgba(255,255,255,.9);box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.2);}
.cov-photo-filled img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;}
.cover .cov-footer{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;font-family:'Nunito';font-size:9pt;margin-top:auto;padding-top:5mm;flex-shrink:0;}
.cover .pill{background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);padding:2mm 4.5mm;border-radius:20mm;font-weight:700;font-size:8pt;}

/* --- TOC --- */
.toc .panel{padding-top:6mm;}
.toc-list{columns:2;column-gap:10mm;margin-top:3mm;}
.toc-item{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:2mm;break-inside:avoid;margin-bottom:4.2mm;font-family:'Nunito';}
.toc-item .tdot{width:2.6mm;height:2.6mm;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;margin-bottom:.6mm;}
.toc-item .ttitle{font-weight:700;font-size:9.6pt;color:var(--ink);flex:1;}
.toc-item .tnum{font-family:'Quicksand';font-weight:700;color:var(--purple-deep);font-size:9.6pt;}

@media print{
  body{background:#fff;}
  .doc{max-width:none;}
  .pdf-page{margin:0;box-shadow:none;page-break-after:always;}
  .bleed-label{display:none;}
}
